messages:
fiona: PR ready for review — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/7123. This touches routing and prefix-cache eviction. Blocking merge until architecture review + RFC alignment. RFC: https://docs.redwood.com/rfcs/2026-06-prefix-evict. cc @josh @arch-team. Short summary: adds new eviction policy flag + config surface. Tests + perf numbers are in the PR description.

josh: looking now. can you paste the SLO delta and the perf numbers inline here? pinging infra/runtime for arm64 perf check.

fiona: quick numbers: p50 unchanged, p95 +3ms on 16k seq synthetic, throughput -2% at 95th percentile (batch_size=8). CPU/GPU util roughly same. Important: feature is opt-in (flag off by default). TL;DR: opt-in rollout but need arch sign-off for behavior and rollout constraints.

kevin: thanks. two quick questions: 1) cross-tenant cache interaction — any chance of mixing? 2) does eviction change KV cache layout that would affect warm-starts?

fiona: no mixing — we shard by tenant_id, eviction is per-shard. added unit tests under `tests/test_eviction_shard.py`. Eviction doesn't alter KV layout format, just metadata eviction markers, so warm-start still compatible. snippet in PR: ```py
def test_eviction_maintains_isolation():
    # ensure tenant shards evict independently
    ...
```

sam: security note — please ensure telemetry doesn't log prompt text or any PII. since this is opt-in, add an audit event when a tenant flips the flag. I'll do a quick review once those lines are in the PR.

ci-bot: CI: all checks green except perf/regression-tests on arm64 (job perf-arm64/regress). tagging @eng-infra for visibility.

josh: :thumbsup: I'll take the architecture pass after arm64 CI stabilizes. If infra confirms the perf regression is limited to arm64 we can gate rollout to x86 initially. fiona — can you add a short canary/rollback plan to the PR description?

fiona: done — added canary: 0.5% traffic for 24h, monitor p95 and error-rate, automatic rollback on >5% p95 regression or >0.1% error increase. linked RFC section 4.2 (rollout strategy) in the PR. PTAL @josh @eng-sre

kevin: ack. I'll add a tiny note on telemetry schema changes in a follow-up commit.
